caption: A row of tea-light candles is lit one after another with a long match, and each flame stands upright after it catches.

sa.check: A long match is held to the candles one after another.
Each candle lights when the match touches it.
Each flame stands upright once lit.
The candles light in order along the row.
The candles not yet touched stay dark.

pc.expect: Each candle lights only when the match touches its wick, and candles the match has not reached stay dark.
pc.fail: A candle lights before the match reaches it; or the match touches a wick and it stays dark to the end of the clip; or every candle lights at once when the first is touched; or a candle at the far end lights while the match works at the near end.

pc.expect: The candles keep their number and their places, and each keeps one wick and one flame.
pc.fail: A second flame appears on one wick; or a candle vanishes; or a new candle appears in the row; or two candles merge into one.

pc.expect: Each flame stands upward from its wick and the wax pools at the candle's top.
pc.fail: A flame points downward; or hangs below its wick; or melted wax climbs a candle's side; or a flame lies flat along the row with nothing blowing it.

pc.expect: Once lit a candle stays lit and the flames do not go out on their own.
pc.fail: A lit candle goes out with nothing touching it; or a flame flickers between lit and out; or a lit flame jumps to an unlit candle; or a lit candle's wax level rises.

pc.expect: The candles keep their cups and shapes and the match stays a stick; nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: A candle's cup changes shape; or the match passes through a candle; or a flame detaches from its wick and floats; or a candle turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The candles' colour, the surface they stand on and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: A candle changes colour; or the surface changes pattern; or the background changes between frames.

note: Who holds the match is not judged.
